theme: founder story (built for my own business)
fb_text:
I didn't build FieldNotes to sell software.

I run a commercial plant service company in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties across the metro. A few years back my phone rang all day: "What's the gate code?" "Where's the key for the lobby?" "You want me to replace that one in the corner?"

Every answer lived in my head. Every question cost both of us ten minutes.

I tried the apps. My crew wouldn't use them — too many screens, too many logins, one more thing between them and the next stop.

So I built the thing that works the way my crew already works: they text. After a stop, my guy sends a quick note like he's texting a buddy. FieldNotes logs it and files it under the right client. When he needs the gate code, he asks the bot — and gets the answer. My phone stays in my pocket.

I built it for my own routes. It runs my business every day. If you run a service crew from your phone, it'll run yours too.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
